data.name: Ivonne
data.gender_notes: Ivonne is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Latin name Ivo, meaning friend, and the suffix -onna, meaning little. Ivonne can be interpreted as a friend of Jesus or a little one loved by God. The name Ivonne carries the meaning “Jesus friend” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Ivonne usually hope their child will grow to embody jesus friend and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that signifies a close connection to the divine.
data.etymology: Ivonne belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Jesus friend.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ivonne total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_latin.name: Ivonne
